title: Local maximal-canard threshold shifts under Runge--Kutta discretization: an observable-specific order condition
summary: Near a planar fast--slow fold, a local maximal canard is selected by the parameter at which the attracting and repelling slow manifolds meet. We compare this threshold for a physical flow and a Runge--Kutta map, using actual invariant manifolds on a common fold section. An order-two Runge--Kutta method has two independent order-three rooted-tree defects. Both enter the pointwise one-step residual, but Gaussian fold transport acts on their leading contribution by $(α,β)\mapsto-3βΞ(J)/8$. Here $Ξ(J)$ is an explicit functional of the fold jet.
